question: If 38% of a number is equal to (5)/(9)th of another number, what is the ratio of the first number to the second number?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the first number be **A** and the second number be **B**.

38% of A = 5/9 of B

A/B = (5/9) ÷ (38/100) = (5/9) × (100/38)

A/B = (5 × 50) / (9 × 19) = 250 / 171

**∴ The correct answer is 250 : 171.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53709424d7020811564c5002af07ada4a6b7740fa57d9e720b6d7b00a478ba17.png] 

**Given:**

**Percentage** of first number (x) = 38%

**Fraction** of second number (y) = 5/9

⇒ 38% × x = (5/9) × y

⇒ (38/100) × x = (5/9) × y

⇒ (19/50) × x = (5/9) × y

⇒ x/y = (5/9) × (50/19)

⇒ x/y = 250 / 171

**∴ The correct answer is 250 : 171.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a **percentage** to a **fraction**, divide the value by 100. Example: x% = x/100.

Ratio and Proportion Basics

If ax = by, then the **ratio** x : y is given by b : a. This is the inverse relationship used in cross-multiplication.

Comparing Fractions

To compare or operate on **ratios**, ensure they are in the simplest form by removing common factors.</p
